pub fn sort<T, K, F>(
            slice: &mut [T],
            Ghost(observation): Ghost<KeyObservation<T>>,
            f: &mut F,
        )
            where
                F: FnMut(&T) -> K,
                K: core::cmp::Ord,
            requires
                observation.domain == old(slice)@,
            ensures
                slice_permutation(old(slice)@, final(slice)@),
                slice_sorted_by_key_observed::<T, K>(final(slice)@, observation),
